CFML Language Reference: Functions

RJustify

Pads a string with spaces on the left so that it ends at the right edge of a field of the given length.

Category

String functions

Syntax

RJustify(string, length)

Parameters

string
The string to justify.
length
Width of the field in characters.

Returns

The padded string. Strings already as long as the field are returned unchanged.

Usage

Right-justified numbers line up nicely in a plain-text report; combine with NumberFormat or DollarFormat.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="GetPay" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets" MAXROWS="6">
SELECT LastName, Salary FROM Employees ORDER BY LastName
</CFQUERY>
<PRE>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="GetPay">#LJustify(LastName, 14)##RJustify(DollarFormat(Salary), 12)#
</CFOUTPUT></PRE>

See also

LJustify, CJustify, DollarFormat, NumberFormat
